Competing Risks Task Generator

Source: R/TaskGeneratorCompRisks.R
mlr_task_generators_cmprsk.Rd

A mlr3::TaskGenerator for simulating right-censored competing risks tasks with numerical baseline covariates.

Uses sim_cmprsk() to generate event times and causes from cause-specific Weibull proportional hazards, with independent right-censoring. The default shape = 1 corresponds to constant cause-specific hazards (exponential event times), while other values allow increasing or decreasing hazards over time.

See sim_cmprsk() for the underlying statistical model, parameter definitions, and defaults.

Details

The generated TaskCompRisks contains the observed time, event, and numerical features x1, ..., xp. Event codes are integers, with 0 indicating censoring and 1, ..., n_causes identifying competing causes.

Generation fails if any requested cause is absent among the observed events. Event and censoring proportions may differ from their specified targets due to sampling variability and covariate effects; see sim_cmprsk() for details.

Use set.seed() before $generate() for reproducibility.

Dictionary

This generator is available through mlr3::mlr_task_generators and mlr3::tgen():

mlr_task_generators$get("cmprsk")
tgen("cmprsk")

Examples

library(mlr3)
library(mlr3cmprsk)

generator = tgen(
  "cmprsk",
  n_features = 5L,
  n_causes = 3L,
  event_probs = c(0.4, 0.2, 0.1)
)

set.seed(42)
task = generator$generate(1000L)
task
#> 
#> ── <TaskCompRisks> (1000x7) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Target: time and event
#> • Properties: -
#> • Features (5):
#>   • dbl (5): x1, x2, x3, x4, x5
#> • Causes (3):
#>   • 1 (Cause 1): 392 (39.2%)
#>   • 2 (Cause 2): 183 (18.3%)
#>   • 3 (Cause 3): 130 (13.0%)
#> • Censored: 295 (29.5%)

# Observed event and censoring proportions
prop.table(table(task$event()))
#> 
#>     0     1     2     3 
#> 0.295 0.392 0.183 0.130
